evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China Electronics Technology Group Corporation 38th Research Institute (CETC 38)”, one of the research institutes of China Electronics Technology Group Corporation (CETC). CETC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and CETC lists the institute among its member units. The US Commerce Department listed it in August 2018, finding an unacceptable risk that it would use US-origin items in, or divert them to, military end-use activities in China.
It belongs to CETC, which describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government.
